pharmacology.text: Butylone acts in a similar way as MDMA and methylone, it causes an increase in extracellular monoamine levels. The following tables lists the half maximal inhibitory and half maximal effective concentrations for norepinephrine, dopamine and serotonin receptors, respectively.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin releasing agent; Norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor; Entactogen

uses.text: As a designer drug, it is commonly sold on the street along with ethylone as a substitute or counterfeit for MDMA and methylone (all of which have collectively come to be referred to as "Molly") due to methylone's declining availability on the research chemical market.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include jaw clenching, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, sweating, overheating, sleeplessness and low mood in the days afterwards. Like other serotonin releasing drugs, it raises the risk of serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括咬牙、心跳與血壓上升、出汗、體溫過高、失眠，以及事後幾天情緒低落。和其他釋放血清素的藥物一樣，它會提高血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括咬牙、心跳与血压上升、出汗、体温过高、失眠，以及事后几天情绪低落。和其他释放血清素的药物一样，它会提高血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: It is the beta keto version of MBDB, which is why one of its names is bk-MBDB. It has often been sold in place of MDMA under the name Molly.
fact.zh: 它是 MBDB 的 β 酮基版本，因此別名之一是 bk-MBDB。它常以 Molly 之名被當作 MDMA 的替代品販售。
fact.zhHans: 它是 MBDB 的 β 酮基版本，因此别名之一是 bk-MBDB。它常以 Molly 之名被当作 MDMA 的替代品贩售。
